description: This Python source file implements transformation logic between OpenAI /v1/embeddings format and Bedrock TwelveLabs Marengo /invoke and /async-invoke format. It provides classes and methods for mapping parameters, transforming requests and responses, and handling both synchronous and asynchronous invocation formats for various media types (text, image, video, audio).

classes.name: TwelveLabsMarengoEmbeddingConfig
classes.description: A class that provides methods to map parameters, transform requests, and responses for converting OpenAI format requests and responses into Bedrock TwelveLabs Marengo /invoke and /async-invoke formats, supporting different media types and async handling.

methods.name: List[str] get_supported_openai_params(self)
methods.description: Returns a list of parameter names supported in OpenAI requests that the class can handle or map.

methods.name: dict map_openai_params( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict )
methods.description: Maps OpenAI parameters to Bedrock parameters, modifying the optional_params dictionary based on non-default parameters.

methods.name: str _extract_bucket_owner_from_params(self, inference_params: dict)
methods.description: Extracts the bucket owner information from inference parameters if present.

methods.name: bool _is_s3_url(self, input: str)
methods.description: Checks whether the provided input string is an S3 URL.

methods.name: Union[TwelveLabsMarengoEmbeddingRequest,TwelveLabsAsyncInvokeRequest] _transform_request( self, input: str, inference_params: dict, async_invoke_route: bool = False, model_id: Optional[str] = None, output_s3_uri: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Transforms an OpenAI-style request into Bedrock format, handling both synchronous and asynchronous routes, media types, and media source encoding.

methods.name: TwelveLabsAsyncInvokeRequest _wrap_async_invoke_request( self, model_input: TwelveLabsMarengoEmbeddingRequest, model_id: str, output_s3_uri: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Wraps a transformed request into the AWS Bedrock async invoke format with the specified model ID and output S3 URI.

methods.name: EmbeddingResponse _transform_response( self, response_list: List[dict], model: str )
methods.description: Transforms a list of TwelveLabs responses into the OpenAI embedding response format, estimating token counts and collecting embeddings.

methods.name: EmbeddingResponse _transform_async_invoke_response( self, response: dict, model: str )
methods.description: Transforms an async invoke response (invocation ARN) into a placeholder OpenAI-style embedding response representing a job.
